prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 16 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1337; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the vehicle was struck while the patient was turning left. The patient reported immediate pain and restricted range of motion in the right shoulder, with difficulty lifting the arm above shoulder height and sleeping on the affected side. Examination revealed tenderness over the anterior shoulder, reduced active abduction and external rotation, and mild weakness on resisted testing. Imaging was reviewed and showed no fracture, with findings consistent with soft tissue strain of the rotator cuff musculature.

Over the course of sixteen visits, treatment consisted of a structured program of manual therapy, progressive therapeutic exercise for scapular stabilization and rotator cuff strengthening, and modalities for pain control as needed. A home exercise program was reinforced at each visit. The patient's pain decreased steadily, and range of motion and strength improved through the course of care. At discharge, the patient demonstrated near-full active range of motion, improved strength, and was able to perform overhead activities with minimal discomfort. Residual mild stiffness remains with extended overhead use. The patient was discharged to an independent home exercise program with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
